verdict.why: STAGE ONE OF THE C3 CHAIN RESTS ON THIS STORE AND IT IS A SAMPLE, NOT A SPINE. Measured at this seat: 8.3% coverage of the canonical node population, 20.0 days stale against a declared 5-minute TTL, no cadence owner, no named owner on ANY row, an id space that shares no mapping with the projection it would have to join to, and a failure mode where substrate-absent is byte-identical to a genuine miss.
